hold_reason: Refunds mismatch: Alpha Co's W2 reported refunds for orders 292 (2929 cents), 294 (10248 cents), and 295 (9055 cents) as applied, but list_refunds shows only orders 294 and 295. Order 292's refund of 2929 cents is missing from the refunds table. No payouts have been recorded. Human review is needed to confirm whether the 292 refund was applied before paying customers, since payouts cannot be recalled.
